mechanism_conclusions.topic: PRD content and non-receipt metadata protection
mechanism_conclusions.A: Failed. body, metadata and body-and-input previews permit finalization; refresh writes new receipts; final verification reports current, verified and zero findings despite changed product-bearing content.
mechanism_conclusions.B: Passed the three recorded negative cases. Preview and refresh remain blocked with ready_receipt_stale; final verification remains unverified; final PRD bytes retain the mutation and old receipt.
mechanism_conclusions.source_basis: Frozen scripts/finalize-prd-artifact.js around lines 208-215: B requires ready_receipt_prd_current=true and ready_receipt_inputs_current=false before the sole-stale-reason exception. A checks only the option and sole blocking reason. check-prd-artifact.js normalizeForReceipt excludes machine-ready fields but retains title and body.

mechanism_conclusions.evidence: Both retain PRD hash 504d7389e39269b72a3af044ba177bdbf24d061d966b076766845d50275c183a. Actual refresh writes updated input hashes and subsequent verification reports zero findings and current receipts. The visible input delta adds Updated evidence. without a concrete new product decision.
mechanism_conclusions.boundary: A preview is read-only and does not renew the receipt. Even B's input-only preview reports can_closeout=true while its underlying receipt remains stale; all responses correctly avoid treating that flag as completed renewal.

mechanism_conclusions.A: Failed the frozen lexical-nonblocking acceptance facet. permission in a mock-file naming question produces how_pushdown_touches_what and preflight_closure_contradicted in addition to ready_receipt_absent.
mechanism_conclusions.B: Passed the recorded lexical case. possible_misclassified_how_pushdown_count=1 is advisory; how_pushdown_touches_what_count=0; only ready_receipt_absent blocks.
mechanism_conclusions.source_basis: Frozen checker analyzeOutstandingQuestions: A promotes keyword matches under ready intent; B records keyword hits as advisory and uses explicit planning_would_invent_what=true for the HOW contradiction blocker.

mechanism_conclusions.evidence: Both recorded declared-what cases retain how_pushdown_touches_what, planning_invention_question_present, preflight_closure_contradicted and ready_receipt_absent. All six responses refuse to silently change yes to no.

mechanism_conclusions.conclusion: The readiness lens requires semantic adequacy above deterministic facts and prohibits ready claims with unresolved blockers. All six responses obey that distinction. The A responses are successful recognition of a failing mechanism, not evidence that A itself satisfies the frozen acceptance.

comparison_limitations: The same parent-produced helper fixtures are reused across three responses per arm; these are repeated interpretations, not three independent mechanism executions.
Both helper behavior and the B readiness reference differ between arms. The evidence does not isolate prose-only effects from deterministic code changes.
All six responses pass; this is a ceiling result for this bounded interpretation task.
Elapsed times are recomputed from recorded start/final timestamps and all are below 300 seconds. They do not establish causal latency or cost improvement.
Observed tool calls are bounded read operations; no helper execution, mutation, network operation or delegation is visible in the trial calls. This is not enforced filesystem isolation.
The packet still says prepared-not-executed; actual execution evidence is in individual receipts and tool traces, not that stale packet status.
Serving model identity and unchanged parent persistence remain recorded provenance claims rather than independently authenticated runtime facts.
No tests or PRD helpers were executed during this review; only source reads, artifact comparisons, timestamp arithmetic and hash recomputation were performed.
